title: Completion Semantics Audit: Authoritative Completion Truth

completed.meaning: Indicates whether the task loop concluded with both postconditions satisfied and task-owned resource cleanup succeeding (lifecycle_ok=True).
completed.value_rationale: True because token was verified in the target window during the action cycle and task-owned processes were terminated cleanly without residue.

postcondition_satisfied.meaning: Indicates whether the goal-required observable state transition occurred while the target application was active.
postcondition_satisfied.value_rationale: True because postcondition_fn(post_obs) affirmatively confirmed token presence on the active edit surface.

final_verified.meaning: Post-cleanup inspection of the desktop looking for the token.
final_verified.contradiction_cause: Because verify_token was called AFTER task cleanup had already closed the task-owned application window, final_obs captured the desktop without the application window. The token was naturally absent, causing verify_token to return False. Reporting this as 'final_verified=false' alongside 'completed=true' created a false appearance that goal completion verification had failed.
final_verified.flaw: Conflating post-cleanup desktop scan with pre-cleanup goal verification.

multi_cycle_revision.meaning: Indicates whether the model executed an alternative capability or argument following a failed earlier cycle.
multi_cycle_revision.value_rationale: False because the scenario succeeded on its very first attempt (cycles=1), requiring zero recovery cycles.

authoritative_completion_contract.invariant: There is exactly ONE authoritative completion truth: completed MUST NEVER be true if goal postcondition verification is false.
authoritative_completion_contract.formal_definition: completed = (pre_teardown_postcondition_verified == True) AND (lifecycle_cleanup_verified == True) AND (residual_debris_detected == False)

restructured_schema.goal_postcondition_verified: bool: True iff target state verified while target application surface was active
restructured_schema.lifecycle_cleanup_verified: bool: True iff all task-created resources were confirmed destroyed
restructured_schema.residual_debris_detected: bool: False iff zero unrequested side effects or orphaned resources remain
restructured_schema.post_cleanup_target_dismissed: bool: True iff target window is confirmed closed (replaces misleading 'final_verified')
restructured_schema.authoritative_completed: bool: True iff goal_postcondition_verified AND lifecycle_cleanup_verified AND NOT residual_debris_detected

authoritative_completion_contract.enforcement_rule: If goal_postcondition_verified is False, authoritative_completed MUST be False. If lifecycle_cleanup_verified is False, authoritative_completed MUST be False.
